context: Small doc-only PRs. The review-protocol skill mirror lives in ~/.skill-sync (shared source; .claude/skills is gitignored) — amend the canonical docs/development/review-protocol.md in-repo and sync the SHARED skill mirror via the skill-sync workflow so the PR carries skill-sync.lock only. Spec amendment is one paragraph scoping the rejection plus a pointer to the findings-domain spec. Owner sign-off on the history stance is recorded in the findings-domain spec's Assumptions section.
description: Gate phase for the findings-domain project (blind-spot findings out of Git, integrated with planning). Two governing documents must be amended BEFORE any capture or schema work, per the 2026-07-22 adversarial review: (1) the tracker spec's 'No offline write queue' rejection (_project/specs/todo-db-tracker.md:69-71, reiterated :556-557) must be narrowed to work-state writes so append-only finding DRAFT FILES are permitted — today the rejection is unscoped and the findings design would silently contradict a standing ADR; (2) review-protocol §4 'Capture is local-only' (docs/development/review-protocol.md:109-126) must name the gitignored draft file as the SOLE write a review-shaped session may perform for findings — direct hosted-DB writes during review are forbidden because hosted writes are immediately cross-session-visible with no PR cycle (spec :54-55), which is the 'landing changes' that §1:31-35 reserves for a separately authorized turn. Also records the owner decision that 'out of Git' means current-tree-only (66 tracked records, 61 commits of history stay; rewriting history is a separate destructive decision), and lands the findings-domain spec itself at _project/specs/findings-domain.md.

anti_patterns.why: It is a standing, twice-stated design decision; contradicting it without amendment re-opens settled debates and hides the ADR trail
